conflicts.disputed: Whether any install.sh user has a retired coryphaeus skill without a manifest. Cooper (OVER-RATE F28): coryphaeus/SKILL.md and the install manifest arrived in the same commit (#32, 8d16107), so the cohort is near-empty; Richards: the harm is clutter, not wrong records. Norman and Delivery-and-Ops (PRIORITIZE F9): a pre-manifest copy keeps a second skill claiming the validator/renderer role. Outcome differs: install.sh must or need not retire coryphaeus without the manifest. Same defect counted twice: F9 escalated to 🔴, F28 demoted to 🟡.

How much harm 'the script is fixed' (chorus-review/SKILL.md:67) does in a stranger's install. Norman (OVER-RATE F20): it fires only when an agent detects a disagreement mid-round; F1 and F11 price the same root at 🟡. Others hold 🔴: Delivery-and-Ops and Cooper derive (R2-) that a patched installed conduct.mjs is then kept as 'differs, kept' on every upgrade with exit 0. Outcome differs: fix before merge (gating) or as follow-up.

What a Node-less agent actually does. Richards (OVER-RATE F7): the installed SKILL.md routes every round through conduct.mjs, so it fails at the first command — 🟡, same as F18. Cooper and Norman: BINDINGS.md:20-22 sends the agent to the 'Free-hand form', so it runs an unscripted round. Outcome differs: a loud failure vs a silent unscripted round.
